description: Export a list of colors as CSS custom properties, SCSS variables, a Tailwind config snippet, W3C design tokens, JSON, or a DESIGN.md `colors:` block.

format.description: Output format: css (custom properties), scss (variables), tailwind (config), tokens (W3C design tokens), json, design-md (DESIGN.md `colors:` YAML for the front matter)

names.description: Optional names for each color. Length must match colors. Defaults to a 50/100…900 scale.

name: export_palette
